title: The common-ion effect
caption: Adding chloride ions to a saturated AgCl solution pushes AgCl(s) ⇌ Ag⁺ + Cl⁻ to the left. Solubility in water is √Ksp = 1.3 × 10⁻⁵ mol dm⁻³; in 0.01 mol dm⁻³ NaCl it falls to Ksp/[Cl⁻] = 1.8 × 10⁻⁸, a thousand times less.
alt: log solubility of AgCl against log chloride concentration: a straight line of gradient −1, with pure water marked at the top left.
description: With added chloride, s = Ksp/[Cl⁻]: a straight line of gradient −1 on log axes.
At [Cl⁻] = 0.01 mol dm⁻³, s = 1.8 × 10⁻⁸ mol dm⁻³.

checks.name: in 0.01 mol dm⁻³ Cl⁻, s = Ksp/[Cl⁻] = 1.8 × 10⁻⁸
